title: Accumulator numeric semantics (cap rate bound + MAX_CREDIT=2 burst ceiling) have no named quantitative assertion — W10's zero-drop pins pass under a lax cap
evidence: stories-v2.md:677-679: "(W10) **one-subscriber-at-cap zero-drop** — a pinned test: a single residential sourcing at its cap over a window shows **zero drops at its own access lane** and no E9 shed at its endpoint" · spec:131-132: "Credit is bounded at a **burst ceiling** `MAX_CREDIT = 2` (a terminal may burst up to 2 in a tick after idling..." — no card pin names a rate, count, or burst assertion; the Golden line (:683-684) is re-bless only: "T1 (spawn sequence shift — **deliberate, cause-documented re-bless**...".

recommended_fix: Add a 5.9 pin: capped-fixture volume test asserting per-terminal rate == cap and per-tick spawns ≤ MAX_CREDIT (extend demand_test's tick_class_count/src_hist machinery), cause-documented with the re-tune.
